subject: Re: Structuring per-token top-ups and seat-independent expansion credits
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@olive-analytics.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@olive-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: New product lines + expected token surge — pricing approach?

Kimberly — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Olive is launching two small product pilots in Q4 that will drive short bursts of Hosted API usage (higher token generation per request). Before we commit, procurement asked us to propose a contract approach that avoids per-team seats and instead lets us add workloads incrementally.

High-level ask: can Redwood offer a top-up/commit model that: 
- lets us allocate a shared burst bucket across teams,
- applies per-token discounts based on cumulative monthly token consumption, and
- includes a 60–90 day grace/buffer for pilot usage while we stabilize traffic.

Can you share a suggested structure (rates, minimums, and any onboarding credits) we could present to finance?

Appreciate it —
Sofia
Head of Product Operations
Olive Analytics

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New product lines + expected token surge — pricing approach?

Hi Sofia — great to connect. Attaching an initial proposal that aims to match Olive's constraints. Summary below, full details in the attached PDF and the modeling workbook you shared.

Key proposal (summary):
- Shared Flex-Bucket: a company-level "burst" bucket (monthly) that teams draw from. Buckets are pre-paid commit credits (per 1M tokens).
- Blended per-token discounts: tiers apply to aggregated monthly consumption across Hosted API only (not Dedicated). Example: 0–50M @ list, 50–250M @ 12% off, 250M+ @ 20% off. Blended pricing is shown in the workbook.
- Pilot Grace Top-up: we offer a 90-day pilot grace policy where the first 50M tokens consumed in pilot workloads are billed at 50% of the listed list rate (effectively a trial discount) and do not count toward breaking the next tier's threshold while pilots run. After 90 days, consumed pilot tokens roll into standard aggregation.
- Seat-independent: no per-seat SKUs. We provide per-workload tagging in billing so you can map consumption to teams and products.
- Minimums & Commit cadence: 6-month rolling commit recommended for predictability. Minimum monthly commit 25M tokens; upfront pre-pay or monthly invoiced with net-30.

Next steps: if this looks directionally right, we can (1) finalize the exact tier breakpoints vs your forecast, (2) route to finance for a spend approval, and (3) produce an SOW with SLAs and pilot grace terms.

I looped Ben (sales) and Lauren (pricing ops) for rate confirmation.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-pricing-flex-bucket-proposal-v1.pdf
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: New product lines + expected token surge — pricing approach?

Quick internal note before we reply to procurement:
- The 50M pilot carve-out seems fine but limit to 90 days and cap at one pilot per customer unless pre-approved; otherwise risk gaming.
- For the blended discounts, recommend we adjust midpoint to 100M/500M (vs 50/250) for Olive's forecast — that pushes them to commit more while giving meaningful breakpoints.
- Suggest a ramp credit: 10% incremental credit applied to the month after pilot ends to soften the transition. Not a long-term discount, just a first-month smoothing credit.

Also flagging: if they want monthly invoicing with net-30 we should add a small finance fee for lower commitment. Lauren, can you confirm margin impact and whether we can approve the 20% top-tier discount?

-ben

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: New product lines + expected token surge — pricing approach?

Ben / Kimberly — ran the numbers against OLIVE forecast file. Notes: 
- 20% top-tier discount is acceptable for committed monthly volumes >= 400M tokens with a 12-month minimum. For a 6-month commit we should cap top-tier at 16%.
- Moving breakpoints to 100M/500M increases forecasted ARR and still leaves headroom.
- Finance fee for month-to-month invoicing (versus upfront pre-pay) should be 1.5% of monthly invoice to offset receivable risk.

I'll incorporate these into the updated proposal. Also, add the 10% ramp credit as a one-time invoice credit in month +1 post-pilot — that should keep the customer happy without long-term concession.

Lauren Bishop
Pricing & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: procurement@olive-analytics.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Structuring per-token top-ups and seat-independent expansion credits

Sofia — thanks for the patience while we modeled options. Attached is an updated proposal (key changes called out below).

Updated offer (high level):
- Breakpoints: 0–100M @ list, 100–500M @ 12% off, 500M+ @ 16% off for 6-month commits. 16% top-tier for 6-month; 20% top-tier available for 12-month commit >=400M/mo.
- Shared Flex-Bucket: sold in 1M token increments. Unused tokens in a month roll forward for one month only.
- Pilot Grace: 90-day pilot window with the first 50M tokens billed at 50% list and excluded from tier calculations. One pilot per account under this concession.
- Ramp credit: one-time 10% invoice credit applied the month after a pilot ends.
- Finance terms: net-30 monthly invoicing acceptable with 1.5% finance fee if not prepaid.
- Billing telemetry: we will provide per-workload tagging and a CSV export for internal chargeback.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-flex-bucket-proposal-v1.pdf (updated), olive-volume-modeling-aug2026.xlsx (your model annotated).

If Olive is comfortable with these guardrails we can (a) produce a short SOW with these terms, (b) generate a DocuSign for approval, and (c) schedule a kickoff so our solutions engineer can help with tagging and onboarding.

Would you like me to route this to procurement/finance for approval now?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Exec, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
